 Explore several landmarks in Cave Point County Park on this E-bike tour
Discover the natural beauty of Cave Point County Park on a fun Door County E-bike tour! This tour takes you to sinkholes in Cave Point County Park, peaceful Clark Lake and some beautiful tree covered windy roads. You can expect to see trees grasping the edge of the cliffs, experience majestic overlooks, and hear the soothing sounds of the surf as we ride along.

The Cave Point area near Jacksonport is well known for its underwater caves and wave-worn limestone cliffs. One of the stops is Clark Lake, one of the largest lakes in Door County. The E Bike Tour is a great way to get around and see everything that this beautiful area has to offer.

Hidden Gems:

Explore secluded alcoves along the limestone cliffs that only locals know about, revealing panoramic views of Lake Michigan.

Traverse lesser-known trails leading to enchanting caves and coves, where the geological formations tell tales of the park’s ancient history.

Uncover the secrets of the park’s unique rock formations, such as sea stacks and fissures, hidden away from the main tourist routes.

Photo Opportunities:

Capture the ethereal beauty of Cave Point’s cliffs as the sun sets, casting a warm glow on the rugged limestone formations.

Frame your shots against the backdrop of Clark Lake, where crystal-clear waters mirror the surrounding greenery and provide a serene setting.

Take advantage of our carefully planned stops at key viewpoints, ensuring you capture the most Instagram-worthy moments of your E-bike adventure.

Flora and Fauna:

Spot rare wildflowers that bloom seasonally, adding bursts of color to the lush landscape.

Keep an eye out for migratory birds, such as bald eagles and peregrine falcons, soaring above the cliffs or nesting in hidden crevices.

Learn about the park’s conservation efforts and how native plant species contribute to the delicate ecosystem of Cave Point County Park.

Local Flavor:

Take a break at a charming local cafe, indulging in Door County cherry pie or other regional specialties.

Visit artisanal shops along the route, where local craftsmen showcase their handmade goods inspired by the natural beauty of Door County.

Interact with friendly locals and get recommendations for hidden gems in the nearby villages, adding a personal touch to your exploration.

Interactive Experience:

Engage in lively discussions with our knowledgeable guides, who will share captivating stories about the park’s formation and its role in local folklore.

Participate in hands-on activities, such as identifying unique rock formations or spotting different bird species with provided binoculars.

Customize your experience by expressing specific interests to our guides, ensuring a tailored and engaging journey through Door County’s natural wonders.

Year-Round Adventure:

Witness the breathtaking transformation of Cave Point County Park during each season, from vibrant fall foliage to the magical ice formations in winter.

Experience the crisp air and invigorating scents of spring as nature awakens, and the park’s flora begins to bloom.

Embrace the summer breeze and the sound of waves crashing against the cliffs, creating a soundtrack to your E-bike adventure that changes with the seasons.

Embark on a Door County E-bike tour for an immersive and detailed exploration of Cave Point County Park’s hidden treasures. Book your adventure today to dive into the unique experiences that each highlight promises!

Now operating year round;  See the ice castles during winter!

Why Take a Door County E – Bike Tour?

See more of the gorgeous Door County, Wisconsin coast in a shorter amount of time.

Less physical effort on your part so the scenery can take your breath away instead of the pedaling!

Adjust the bike’s electric assistance to fit your preferences. It’s suitable both for people who want a good workout and for those that don’t want to expend much energy on the tour.

Easier than a segway and a whole lot cooler!
